2  This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e cour  following:
 ORDER
With the consent of the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

2. This miscellaneous appeal has been filed by the appellant under section 173 (1) of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 against the award dt. 14.2.2023 passed in MACC No.661/2019 by 7th Member, MACT,
Satna seeking enhancement of compensation.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Tribunal has wrongly determined deceased's income as Rs.30,000/- per annum, which should have been determined on the basis of minimum wages.
On above grounds, it is urged that compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably enhanced.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent insurance company submits that just and proper compensation has been awarded by the Tribunal to the appellant.

Hence, no enhancement is required in the case and appeal be dismissed.
5.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
6. So far as income of deceased is concerned, on the date of incident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.7700/-.

There is no dispute with respect to multiplier to be applied,
deductions to be made and future prospects to be added.

Hence, in view of above, compensation is recalculated as under:-
 PARTICULARS AMOU  MONTHLY INCOME Rs.7  YEARLY INCOME Rs.92  Deductions 1/2 Rs.46  Future Prospects 40% Rs.64  Multiplier of 18 Rs.11,6  Loss of estate Rs.15  Funeral Expenses Rs.18  Consortium Rs.80  TOTAL Rs.12,7
TRIBUNAL AWARDED RS.4,99
